alerts.title: Abdominal Pain
alerts.message: Guidelines mention abdominal pain as a side effect of certain medications, such as DTG. Patient presents with abdominal pain but no fever. Evidence for drug attribution includes DTG's known side effects, but non-drug causes like infection or other comorbidities should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Investigate non-drug causes and monitor patient
